Ha Long will bring visitors interesting experiences, if you are wondering what is beautiful about Ha Long tourism in September, then let’s refer to the full set of Ha Long tourism experiences in September below with Vietlook.

Reasons why you like to travel to Ha Long in September

In September, Ha Long weather begins to enter autumn, the cool and clear weather is very convenient for tourists’ picnic trips, or interesting Ha Long cruise tours, when gliding through famous landscapes and mysterious caves.

Ha Long tourist attractions in September

Sun World Park

As the leading entertainment area in Ha Long, meeting all the needs of tourists, suitable for all ages, coming here visitors will experience interesting services such as cable cars, or participating in water games that will bring visitors exciting experiences.

Quang Ninh Museum

Coming here, visitors will learn about the historical culture of Quang Ninh. Currently, the museum is a place to display artifacts and images of cultural and historical documents through each period.

Titop Island

With a clear blue beach and white sand, it is very suitable for swimming or participating in games on the sea, it is an indispensable destination when traveling to Ha Long in the summer.

Luon Cave

As one of the small caves, to get here, visitors should experience kayaking through the rocky gorges to climb to visit the beauty of Luon Cave.

Things to note when traveling to Ha Long in September

  • You should bring a wide-brimmed hat and sunglasses when going to the beach
  • You should bring light, airy clothes and things to swim
  • Shoes are also very important for visitors’ beach trips.
  • You should also bring digestive enzymes to prevent when you eat seafood…

So now you probably have your own answer for what is beautiful about a trip to Ha Long in September. Hopefully, with the experiences of traveling to Ha Long in September that Vietlook has just shared above, it will help make your trip perfect.
